paragraphs: Oregon State University (OSU) is a public land-grant research university in Corvallis, Oregon, founded in 1868 as Corvallis College and renamed Oregon State University in 1961. It is the state's largest university with nearly 38,000 students and one of only two American universities to hold land-grant, sea-grant, space-grant and sun-grant designations.

OSU's main campus spans 420 acres in the Willamette Valley, 83 miles south of Portland, and is organised into 11 colleges plus an Honors College. The College of Engineering is the fifth-largest in the United States, the College of Earth, Ocean, and Atmospheric Sciences ranks among the top 5 globally for oceanography, and the College of Agricultural Sciences is ranked in the world's top 50.

Oregon State is consistently ranked in the top 10 for online education by U.S. News & World Report (Ecampus, 12 consecutive years) and Corvallis is named the #1 college town on the West Coast. Distinctive research strengths include climate science, robotics, clean energy, marine science, biotechnology and forestry — backed by 11 Agricultural Experiment Stations and 10 research forests across Oregon.

International students enter Oregon State directly or via the INTO OSU partnership — International Year One, Undergraduate Transfer Program, Graduate Pathway, Pathway MBA/MSB and Academic English routes lead into OSU bachelor's, master's and PhD degrees. The cohort spans 100+ countries with a vibrant International Living-Learning Center on the Corvallis campus.

Основан в 1868 как Corvallis College, переименован в Oregon State University в 1961. Крупнейший университет штата — почти 38 000 студентов, один из двух университетов США со статусами land-grant, sea-grant, space-grant и sun-grant.

Главный кампус — 420 акров в долине Willamette, 83 мили южнее Portland. 11 colleges плюс Honors College. College of Engineering — пятый по размеру в США. College of Earth, Ocean, and Atmospheric Sciences — топ-5 в мире по oceanography. College of Agricultural Sciences — топ-50 в мире.

Стабильно входит в топ-10 по online education по версии U.S. News (Ecampus, 12 лет подряд). Corvallis — #1 college town западного побережья США. Сильные направления: climate science, robotics, clean energy, marine science, biotech, forestry. Поддержка — 11 Agricultural Experiment Stations и 10 research forests по всему штату Oregon.

Международные студенты заходят напрямую или через партнёрство INTO OSU — International Year One, Undergraduate Transfer Program, Graduate Pathway, Pathway MBA/MSB и Academic English ведут в бакалавриат, магистратуру и PhD OSU.
